SELECT ai.activity_id AS activity_id, ai.item_id AS item_id, ai.goods_id AS goods_id, ai.company_id AS company_id, ai.activity_price AS activity_price, ai.activity_store AS activity_store, ai.limit_fee AS limit_fee, ai.limit_num AS limit_num, ai.sort AS sort, ai.shelf_status AS shelf_status, ai.created AS created, ai.updated AS updated, it.item_name AS item_name, it.goods_bn AS goods_bn, it.item_bn AS item_bn, it.nospec AS nospec, it.store AS store, it.price AS price, it.pics AS pics, it.default_item_id AS default_item_id, it.is_medicine AS is_medicine, it.is_prescription AS is_prescription FROM employee_purchase_activity_items ai LEFT JOIN items it ON ai.item_id = it.item_id WHERE ai.company_id = #{companyId} AND ai.activity_id = #{activityId} AND ai.goods_id IN
#{gid}
AND ai.shelf_status = #{shelfStatus}
AND it.item_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY
it.sales DESC, ai.item_id DESC
ai.activity_price DESC, ai.item_id DESC
ai.activity_price ASC, ai.item_id DESC
ai.sort DESC, ai.item_id DESC
ai.item_id DESC
ai.item_id DESC
